create_EVA_agent: create an EVAAgent instance to solve games using Ephemeral Value Adjustment with configurable DQN and embedding networks
build_queryable_replay_buffer: build a QueryableFixedSizeRingBuffer that supports KNN retrieval of transitions by L2 proximity to embedding vectors
run_EVA_step: run an EVA agent step to select actions via epsilon-greedy policy and update parametric and non-parametric Q-values
compute_action_probabilities: compute action probabilities for a game state using the EVA agent's learned Q-values and legal actions mask
test_trajectory_centric_planning: test trajectory-centric planning to update non-parametric values using KNN-retrieved replay buffer trajectories
